_doc: Specialty / import-defined ingredients — NOT part of the 100-ingredient wholesale-priced corpus. These carry a US Census import stream (and, where sourced, a book yield) but NO wholesale price band, posture, seasonality or co-movement, because no USDA/BLS wholesale reference tracks them. Every such field is honestly absent. Appended to the Ingredient State Record after the 100 priced ingredients, flagged specialty:true. Import columns are US public domain; the compiled record is CC BY 4.0.
